title: Partial release of a consumed tree
summary: Proves the compiler's release of the records a function drops from a consumed tree: a child released before the matched record is rewritten; the moved children's slots cleared and the matched record released after the result is taken; and, at the end of a branch, the release of each owned tree that another branch of the same if or match consumes.
premises: A consumed tree argument, owned with pairwise disjoint blocks
Heap.At and a memory cap of at most 65,535 pages
result: Heap.Rebuilt over the consumed blocks for the value the function returns, from which Func.implements_rebuilt gives Implements.
